scenario.narrative: SYNTHETIC: a drone sighting closes runway 17C at DFW from T+1 to T+16 min while AAL2335 is on approach.

closure.cause: Drone sighting within 2 NM of the runway threshold; runway closed until cleared

messages.reason: S34-A1 gives knock_on_min 0.2 with wake_margin 0.21 and window_load 0.64, and all land slots are after the 15.9 min closure end. DIVERT-ACT removes arrivals entirely (window_load 0.0), so it is last.
red_lines: No landing slot inside the 0.7 to 15.9 min closure of runway 17C
No candidate with wake_margin_min below 0.05
No candidate with knock_on_min above 1.5 without a stated reason
Arrival rate must not fall below the 33/hr cap in the window

messages.reason: S22-A1 keeps the highest fuel margin among landings at 19.1 min with the least holding (18 min, 720 kg) and 36 missed pax, while DIVERT-ACT strands 113 pax and has a higher cost of 135.9.
red_lines: Fuel margin must stay above the legal minimum with no less than 5 min buffer
Holding beyond 30 min (S34-A1 or later) is not acceptable
Divert only if no landing slot preserves fuel margin above minimum

messages.reason: Earliest landing S22-A1 gives the lowest overtime (10 min) and departure delay (12 min), and every LAND option forces a gate change from A6 to A1. DIVERT-ACT avoids the gate change but adds 180 min departure delay, so it ranks last.
red_lines: Overtime above 10 min on the ramp crew
Departure delay above 30 min for this aircraft

messages.reason: S22-A1 lands at T+22.0, after the 17C closure ends at T+15.9, with knock_on_min 0.3 and wake_margin_min 0.21, and window_load 0.58 stays under the 33/hr arrival cap. It is the lowest-knock-on landing option that clears the closure.
red_lines: No landing on 17C inside the closure window T+0.7 to T+15.9

messages.reason: S22-A1 has the lowest hold fuel among landing options at 720 kg with an 18 min hold and a 19.1 min fuel margin above the legal minimum. It also avoids the 113 missed passengers of a divert, and its 36 missed pax match the other landing options.
